meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可通过工具调用 lsp 系列 MCP 工具，做语言服务器诊断、跳转定义、查找引用、查看符号、重命名校验与执行重命名；这些是工具名，不是 shell 命令。
howto.when: 当你在当前工作区需要语言服务器诊断、定义、引用等检查时会触发；若诊断提示缺少语言服务器，先运行 lsp.status 查看。

say.text: 用 lsp 检查这个文件有哪些报错
用 lsp 找这个符号在整个项目里的引用
say.note: 调用 lsp.find_references 扫描工作区

say.text: 用 lsp 把这个符号改名

howto.what_en: Claude gains lsp MCP tools to run language-server diagnostics, go-to-definition, find references, inspect symbols, and check or apply renames in the workspace. These are tool-call names, not shell commands.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace; run lsp.status first if a language server is missing.

say_en.text: Use lsp to check this file for errors
say_en.note: Runs lsp.diagnostics; error severity is preferred after edits

say_en.text: Use lsp to find all references to this symbol
Use lsp to rename this symbol
say_en.note: prepare_rename validates, then rename applies the edit
